label: volume-known-answer-baseline
workload: Two known-answer scenes for the cut-fill volume. Points are drawn from a fixed-seed LCG, so every figure is deterministic. truthM3 is the closed form; legacyM3 is the point-weighted v1/v2 arithmetic on the same input; recordedM3 is the shipping area-weighted figure at this revision; toleranceRel bounds |recorded - truth| / truth.

cases.description: 10 m x 10 m polygon, reference z = 0; 900 points at z = 1 uniform on x < 5, 100 points at z = 0 uniform on x > 5 (LCG seed 12345).
L-shaped slab [0,10]x[0,2] U [0,2]x[0,10] (36 m^2) sampled every 0.1 m, z = 1 except a z = 0 rim on x < 0.05 or y < 0.05; footprint is the drawn L lasso, reference the 5th percentile.
